about_bytm_content_markdown:
Version `${scriptVersion}` (build [`#${buildNumber}`](${buildBrowseLink}) from ${buildDate})

---

${scriptName} enhances the YouTube Music experience by adding many features, improvements and overhauls.  
It's developed by [${authorName}](${authorLink}) and [contributors](${contributorsLink}) and is available on [GitHub](${githubLink}), [Greasy Fork](${greasyforkLink}) and [OpenUserJS.](${openuserjsLink})  
If you like ${scriptName}, [please consider funding the development ❤️](${fundingLink})  
[Join the Discord server](${discordLink}) to receive update notifications, to discuss issues or suggest features, and to chat with members.

---

${scriptName} is **not affiliated** with YouTube or Google **in any way.**  
Copyright © ${currentYear} ${authorName}. Licensed under the [${licenseName}.](${licenseUrl})
feature_group_header.numKeysSkipToTime: Number Keys to Skip to Time:
feature_desc.watermarkEnabled: Show a watermark under the site logo that opens this config menu
feature_helptext.watermarkEnabled:
If this is disabled, you can still open the config menu by clicking the option in the menu that opens when you click your profile picture in the top right corner.
However it will be harder to find the easter egg ;)
feature_desc.removeShareTrackingParam: Remove the source identifier parameter "si" from the URL in share menus
feature_helptext.removeShareTrackingPara: For analytics purposes YouTube adds the source identifier parameter "si" to the end of the URL you can copy in the share menu. While not directly harmful, it makes the URL longer and allows YouTube to collect advertising information like common interests of you and your social circles.
feature_desc.removeShareTrackingParamSit: On which sites should the share tracking parameter be removed?
feature_desc.fixSpacing: Fix spacing issues in the layout
feature_helptext.fixSpacing: There are various locations in the user interface where the spacing between elements is inconsistent. This feature fixes those issues.
feature_desc.thumbnailOverlayBehavior: When to automatically replace the video element with its thumbnail in the highest resolution
feature_helptext.thumbnailOverlayBehavio:
The thumbnail will be shown over top of the currently playing video/song as an overlay.
This means you will not save any bandwidth as the video will still be loaded and played in the background!
feature_desc.thumbnailOverlayToggleBtnSh: Add a button to the media controls to manually toggle the thumbnail
feature_helptext.thumbnailOverlayToggleB:
This button will allow you to manually toggle the thumbnail on and off. This is not affected if the thumbnail replacement option is set to "never".
Once a new video/song starts playing, the default state will be restored.
Hold shift while clicking or press the middle mouse button to open the thumbnail of the highest quality in a new tab.
feature_desc.thumbnailOverlayITunesImgRe: Resolution of the Apple Music / iTunes album artwork
feature_desc.thumbnailOverlayAlbumArtCac: Maximum amount of album art entries to keep in the cache
feature_helptext.thumbnailOverlayAlbumAr:
The album artworks of songs you listen to are stored in a cache to reduce the amount of requests to the album art provider.
This feature allows you to set the maximum amount of album art entries to keep in the cache.
When the limit is reached, the oldest entry will be removed to make space for any new ones.
feature_desc.thumbnailOverlayAlbumArtCac: Maximum amount of days to keep an album art entry in the cache
feature_helptext.thumbnailOverlayAlbumAr:
The cache that album artworks are stored in will automatically delete them after this amount of time to ensure that updates to the source are being fetched sooner or later.
If you wanna make sure that you always have the most recent album artwork, set this to a low value like 7 days.
feature_desc.thumbnailOverlayShowIndicat: Show an indicator in the bottom right corner of the thumbnail while it's active
feature_desc.thumbnailOverlayPreferredSo: The preferred source for the thumbnail overlay
feature_helptext.thumbnailOverlayPreferr: Apple Music / iTunes album artwork has a much higher resolution than YouTube thumbnails, but can sometimes be incorrect.
feature_desc.hideCursorOnIdle: Hide the cursor after a few seconds of inactivity over the video
feature_desc.hideCursorOnIdleDelay: How many seconds of inactivity before the cursor should be hidden
feature_desc.fixHdrIssues: Prevent some rendering issues when using an HDR-compatible GPU and monitor
feature_desc.showVotes: Show the amount of likes and dislikes on the currently playing song
feature_helptext.showVotes: This feature is powered by Return YouTube Dislike and will show the approximate amount of likes and dislikes on the currently playing song.
feature_desc.swapLikeDislikeButtons: Swap the position of the like and dislike buttons
feature_helptext.swapLikeDislikeButtons: On YT, the like button is on the left side. On YTM it's the other way around. Enabling this feature makes the two pages consistent by swapping them around on YTM.
feature_desc.watchPageFullSize: Make the main content on the /watch page use all available space
feature_desc.volumeSliderExponential: The scale to use for the volume slider
feature_helptext.volumeSliderExponential:
By default, the volume slider uses a linear scale, meaning the volume increases evenly from 0% to 100%. With this feature enabled, the scale becomes approximately exponential, meaning the volume is more finely graded in the lower ranges and increases more rapidly in the higher ranges. This can be helpful if you have trouble adjusting the volume precisely in the lower ranges.

See also https://www.dr-lex.be/info-stuff/volumecontrols.html
feature_desc.volumeSliderExponentialLabe: The type of volume label to show when using the exponential scale
feature_helptext.volumeSliderExponential:
When using the exponential scale, the volume slider can show different types of labels to indicate the current volume level:

- Position-based: Shows the position of the slider as a percentage (0% to 100%)
- Value-based: Shows the actual perceived volume level as a percentage (0% to 100%)
- Both: Shows the position value, followed by the perceived volume level in parentheses
feature_desc.volumeSliderLabel: Add a percentage label next to the volume slider
feature_desc.volumeSliderSize: The width of the volume slider in pixels
feature_desc.volumeSliderStep: Volume slider sensitivity (by how little percent the volume can be changed at a time)
feature_desc.volumeSliderScrollStep: Volume slider scroll wheel sensitivity in percent
feature_helptext.volumeSliderScrollStep: By how much percent the volume should be changed when changing the volume slider using the mouse wheel.
feature_desc.volumeSharedBetweenTabs: Share one volume between all tabs and remember the volume across sessions
feature_helptext.volumeSharedBetweenTabs:
If you change the volume in one tab, the volume level will be set to the same value in all other tabs that have this feature enabled.
This value will be remembered and restored across sessions, until disabled.
feature_desc.setInitialTabVolume: Set the volume level to a specific value when loading the site for the first time
feature_warning.setInitialTabVolume_volu: This feature is incompatible with the "Volume level shared between tabs" feature and will be ignored while using the shared volume feature!
feature_desc.initialTabVolumeLevel: The value to set the volume level to when opening the site
feature_desc.lyricsQueueButton: Add a button to each song in a list to open its lyrics page
feature_desc.deleteFromQueueButton: Add a button to each song in a list to quickly remove it
feature_desc.listButtonsPlacement: Where should the list buttons show up?
feature_helptext.listButtonsPlacement:
There are various song lists on the site like album pages, playlists and the currently playing queue.
With this option you can choose where the list buttons should show up.
feature_desc.scrollToActiveSongBtn: Add a button above the queue to scroll to the currently playing song
feature_desc.clearQueueBtn: Add a button above the currently playing queue or playlist to quickly clear it
feature_desc.aboveQueueBtnsSticky: Always position the element containing the buttons above the queue at the top of the list
feature_desc.songListTrackNumbersEnabled: Add track numbers to song lists
feature_desc.songListTrackNumbers: Where should the track numbers be shown?
feature_desc.disableBeforeUnloadPopup: Prevent the confirmation popup that appears when trying to leave the site while a video is playing
feature_helptext.disableBeforeUnloadPopu:
When trying to leave the site while a few seconds into a video that is actively playing, a popup will appear asking you to confirm that you want to leave the site. It might say something along the lines of "you have unsaved data" or "this site is asking if you want to close it".
This feature disables that popup entirely.
feature_desc.autoCloseToasts: Automatically close toast notifications that are usually permanent
feature_helptext.autoCloseToasts:
Most toast notifications that appear in the bottom left corner will close automatically after 3 seconds with the exception of certain ones like when liking a video.
With this feature enabled, the permanent toasts will be automatically closed. The other kind will stay unaffected.
feature_desc.closeToastsTimeout: After how many seconds to close the toasts
feature_desc.rememberSongTime: Remember the last video's time when reloading or restoring the tab
feature_helptext.rememberSongTime-1:
Sometimes when reloading the page or restoring it after accidentally closing it, you want to resume listening at the same point. This feature allows you to do that.
In order to record the video's time, you need to play it for %1 second, then its time will be remembered and be restorable for a short while.
feature_helptext.rememberSongTime-n:
Sometimes when reloading the page or restoring it after accidentally closing it, you want to resume listening at the same point. This feature allows you to do that.
In order to record the video's time, you need to play it for %1 seconds, then its time will be remembered and be restorable for a short while.
feature_desc.rememberSongTimeSites: On which sites should the video time be remembered and restored?
feature_desc.rememberSongTimeDuration: How long to remember the video's time for after it was last played in seconds
feature_desc.rememberSongTimeReduction: How many seconds to subtract when restoring the time of a remembered video
feature_helptext.rememberSongTimeReducti: When restoring the time of a video that was remembered, this amount of seconds will be subtracted from the remembered time so you have more context when watching or listening to the part that was interrupted again.
feature_desc.rememberSongTimeMinPlayTime: Minimum amount of seconds a video needs to be played for its time to be remembered
feature_desc.autoScrollToActiveSongMode: When to scroll to the currently playing video in the queue
feature_desc.yesImStillThere: Automatically dismiss the "Are you still there?" popup that appears after some inactivity
feature_desc.arrowKeySupport: Use arrow keys to skip forwards and backwards and to change the volume
feature_helptext.arrowKeySupport:
Normally you can only skip forwards and backwards by a fixed 10 second interval with the keys "H" and "L". This feature allows you to use the arrow keys to skip forwards and backwards and change the volume.
To change the amount of seconds to skip, use the option below.
feature_desc.arrowKeySkipBy: By how many seconds to skip when using the arrow keys
feature_desc.arrowKeyVolumeStep: How many percent to increase or decrease the volume by when using the arrow keys
feature_desc.frameSkip: Use the period and comma keys to skip forwards and backwards by a frame when the video is paused
feature_desc.frameSkipWhilePlaying: Also allow skipping by a frame while the video is still playing
feature_desc.frameSkipAmount: How many seconds to skip with the period and comma keys
feature_helptext.frameSkipAmount: This same feature which is natively available on YT skips by a fixed value of about 0.0166 seconds. If needed, adjust it to a different value here.
feature_desc.anchorImprovements: Add and improve clickable elements on the page
feature_helptext.anchorImprovements:
Some elements on the page are only clickable with the left mouse button, some have quite the small hitbox, and some aren't clickable at all.
This feature adds and improves clickable elements all over the page to make it easier to interact with them, or quickly open them in a new tab using the middle mouse button or shift-click and shift-rightclick.
feature_desc.autoLikeChannels: Automatically like all videos and songs of certain channels
feature_helptext.autoLikeChannels:
Once enabled, you can enable this feature for certain channels by opening their page and clicking the toggle button. Afterwards, any video/song you play of that channel will be liked automatically.
Use the option below to open a dialog to manage the channels.
feature_desc.autoLikeChannelToggleBtn: Add a button to each channel page to enable or disable auto-liking
feature_desc.autoLikePlayerBarToggleBtn: Add a button to the media controls to enable or disable auto-liking
feature_desc.autoLikeTimeout: How many seconds a video/song needs to play before being auto-liked
feature_desc.autoLikeShowToast: Show a toast notification when a video/song is auto-liked
feature_desc.autoLikeOpenMgmtDialog: Open the dialog to manage auto-liked channels
feature_desc.numKeysSkipToTime: Enable skipping to a specific time in the video by pressing a number key (0-9)
feature_desc.numKeysSkipToTimeDoublePres: Whether a double press of the number key is required and in which time frame
feature_helptext.numKeysSkipToTimeDouble:
If enabled, you need to double-press the number key within this time frame to skip to the specific time in the video. This works on both YTM and YT.
Increase the time if you have trouble double-pressing the key in time.
If disabled, a single press of the number key is enough to skip to the specific time in the video.
feature_desc.numKeysSkipToTimeDoublePres: Whether there's a double-press buffer time when close to the associated timestamp and how long
feature_helptext.numKeysSkipToTimeDouble: If enabled, a double-press won't be required when the pressed number key's timestamp and the current video/song time are within this time frame.
feature_desc.switchBetweenSites: Add a hotkey to switch between the YT and YTM sites on a video/song
feature_helptext.switchBetweenSites: Pressing this hotkey will switch to the other site if you are on YouTube or YouTube Music while staying on the same video/song.
feature_desc.switchSitesHotkey: Hotkey to switch between the sites
feature_desc.likeDislikeHotkeys: Add hotkeys to like and dislike the currently playing video/song
feature_desc.likeDislikeHotkeysToggle: Allow the hotkeys to toggle the like/dislike state off again
feature_helptext.likeDislikeHotkeysToggl: When enabled, pressing the like or dislike hotkey again will remove your like or dislike from the video/song. If disabled, you can only ever set the like or dislike buttons to be active via the hotkey, but not unset them.
feature_desc.likeHotkey: Hotkey to like the current video/song
feature_desc.dislikeHotkey: Hotkey to dislike the current video/song
feature_desc.currentLyricsHotkeyEnabled: Add a hotkey to open the current song's lyrics in a new tab
feature_desc.currentLyricsHotkey: Hotkey to open the song's lyrics
feature_desc.skipToRemTimeHotkeyEnabled: Add a hotkey to restore the last remembered timestamp of the current video/song
feature_helptext.skipToRemTimeHotkeyEnab:
By pressing the hotkey from the feature below, the feature restores the furthest timestamp the video was at, within the configured time frame.
This will only work if the "Remember song time" feature is enabled.
feature_warning.skipToRemTimeHotkeyEnabl: This feature will only work if the "Remember song time" feature is enabled.
feature_desc.skipToRemTimeHotkey: Hotkey to restore the last remembered timestamp
feature_desc.focusSearchBarHotkeyEnabled: Add a hotkey to focus the search bar
feature_desc.focusSearchBarHotkey: Hotkey to focus the search bar
feature_desc.clearSearchBarHotkeyEnabled: Add a hotkey to clear the search bar
feature_desc.clearSearchBarHotkey: Hotkey to clear the search bar
feature_desc.rebindNextAndPrevious: Rebind the hotkeys to skip to the next (J) or previous (K) video/song
feature_desc.nextHotkey: Hotkey to skip to the next video/song
feature_desc.previousHotkey: Hotkey to skip to the previous video/song
feature_desc.rebindPlayPause: Rebind the hotkey to play or pause the current video/song (Space)
feature_desc.geniusLyrics: Add a button to the media controls of the currently playing song to open its lyrics on genius.com
feature_desc.errorOnLyricsNotFound: Show an error when the lyrics page for the currently playing song couldn't be found
feature_desc.geniUrlBase: Base URL of your geniURL instance, see https://github.com/Sv443/geniURL
feature_helptext.geniUrlBase:
If you have your own instance of geniURL running (for example to bypass rate limiting), you can enter its  URL here to use it for the genius.com lyrics button.
If you don't know what this is, you can leave this option as is.
feature_desc.geniUrlToken: Auth token for your geniURL instance
feature_helptext.geniUrlToken: To bypass rate limiting, you can provide an auth token that is also defined in the .env file of your geniURL instance.
feature_desc.lyricsCacheMaxSize: Maximum amount of lyrics to keep in the cache
feature_helptext.lyricsCacheMaxSize:
The lyrics of songs you listen to are stored in a cache to reduce the amount of requests to the lyrics provider.
This feature allows you to set the maximum amount of lyrics to keep in the cache.
When the limit is reached, the oldest entry will be removed to make space for any new ones.
feature_desc.lyricsCacheTTL: Max amount of days to keep a lyrics entry in the cache
feature_helptext.lyricsCacheTTL:
The cache that lyrics are stored in will automatically delete them after this amount of time to ensure that updates to the source are being fetched sooner or later.
If you wanna make sure that you always have the most recent lyrics, set this to a low value like 7 days.
feature_helptext.clearLyricsCache: If the lyrics that are in the local cache are outdated or you just want to free up some space, you can clear the cache manually by pressing this button.
feature_desc.advancedLyricsFilter: Experimental: Enable advanced filtering for the lyrics search
feature_helptext.advancedLyricsFilter:
Advanced filtering includes multiple layers of filters that aim to make the lyrics lookups more reliable.
These filters may not work well for songs in your language, and songs and artists with less unique titles in general.
Warning: This feature is still experimental and might not actually perform any better than the default lyrics lookup. Make sure to confirm the prompt that appears if you changed this setting.
feature_desc.disableDarkReaderSites: On which sites the Dark Reader extension should be disabled to fix layout issues
feature_helptext.disableDarkReaderSites:
The Dark Reader extension can cause issues with the layout of the site.
This feature allows you to disable Dark Reader on certain or all sites to prevent those issues.

If the extension is not installed, this feature will have no effect and can be left activated.
feature_desc.sponsorBlockIntegration: Make some fixes to the layout in case SponsorBlock is installed
feature_helptext.sponsorBlockIntegration:
If you have the SponsorBlock extension installed, this feature will make some fixes to the layout of the site to prevent issues that might occur.

This feature will have no effect if the extension is not installed and can be left activated in that case.
feature_desc.themeSongIntegration: Fix some styling issues if the ThemeSong extension is installed
feature_helptext.themeSongIntegration:
If the ThemeSong extension is installed but this feature is turned off (or vice versa), you might notice broken styling on the site.

Please always make sure this feature reflects whether the extension is installed or not!
feature_desc.themeSongLightness: How light the accent colors should be that are derived from the current ThemeSong theme
feature_helptext.themeSongLightness:
Depending on the settings you chose for the ThemeSong extension, this feature allows you to adjust the lightness of the accent colors that are derived from the current theme.

This feature will have no effect if the ThemeSong extension is not installed.
feature_desc.removeThumbnailRatingBar: Remove the rating bar added by the "Thumbnail Rating Bar" extension
feature_helptext.removeThumbnailRatingBa:
If you have the "Thumbnail Rating Bar" extension installed, you will notice a rating bar on every song and video thumbnail, which are absolutely tiny on YT Music.
This feature will remove that rating bar to prevent it from taking up space and being distracting.

This feature will have no effect if the extension is not installed and can be left activated in that case.
feature_desc.openPluginList: Open the list of plugins you have installed
feature_desc.initTimeout: How many seconds to wait for features to initialize before considering them to likely be in an errored state
feature_helptext.initTimeout:
This is the amount of time in seconds that the script will wait for features to initialize before considering them to likely be in an errored state.
This will not affect the script's behavior in a significant way, but if one of your plugins can't initialize in time, you should try increasing this value.
feature_desc.localeFallback: Use English as a fallback for missing translations (disable if you are contributing translations)
feature_helptext.versionCheck:
This feature checks for updates every 24 hours, notifies you if a new version is available and allows you to update the script manually.
If your userscript manager extension updates scripts automatically, you can disable this feature.
feature_desc.checkVersionNow: Manually check for a new version
feature_desc.logLevel: How much information to log to the console
feature_helptext.logLevel:
Changing this is really only needed for debugging purposes as a result of experiencing a problem.
Should you have one, you can increase the log level here, open your browser's JavaScript console (usually with Ctrl + Shift + K) and attach screenshots of that log in a GitHub issue.
feature_desc.logEvents: Log interface and site events to the console
feature_helptext.logEvents: This will log events that occur on both internally used event systems to the console. This is useful for debugging purposes and for making plugins.
feature_desc.toastDuration: For how many seconds custom toast notifications should be shown - 0 to disable them
feature_desc.showToastOnGenericError: Show a notification when an error occurs
feature_helptext.showToastOnGenericError:
Should an error occur in the script that prevents parts of it from working correctly, a notification will be shown to inform you about it.
If you encounter a problem often, please copy the error from the JavaScript console (usually in the F12 menu) and please open an issue on GitHub.
feature_desc.resetConfig: Reset all settings to their default values
feature_helptext.resetConfig: This will reset all settings to their default values. However it won't affect data such as auto-liked channels or the lyrics cache.
feature_desc.resetEverything: Reset all stored data to the default values
feature_helptext.resetEverything:
The data that will be reset to the defaults includes the feature configuration, the lyrics cache and auto-liked channels.
This is useful if you want a soft reset with a clean slate, like when you are experiencing weird problems.
feature_helptext.advancedMode:
After enabling this, the menu will reload and show advanced settings that are hidden by default.
This is useful if you want to more deeply customize the script's behavior and don't care about an overcrowded menu.
